mft.name: Meme for Trees
mft.description: MfT is the core value-routing token of the entire ecosystem. Every game action, NFT sale, and reactor cycle burns MfT. Gardens convert gameplay yield into MfT liquidity, the NFT marketplace takes a 1% MfT buy-and-burn on every purchase, and reactors burn MfT alongside partner tokens on every cycle. MfT is designed to be permanently deflationary — more is burned than enters circulation.
mft.role: Hub token. All game economies, impact strategies, and reactor networks route value through MfT burns.
mechanics: 1% buy-and-burn on every NFT purchase (eggs, flowers, pots, houses)

No mint function — fixed supply, only burns

earth.name: EARTH
earth.description: EARTH is a deflationary rebase token on Base. Its reactor burns more tokens than it mints each cycle, causing the rebase index to increase over time. 9 reactor pools run 24/7, collecting fees from WETH, USDC, cbBTC, and community token pairs. The reactor executes on a cooldown timer, making the entire process trustless and automatic.
earth.role: Deflationary flywheel. Burns exceed mints, increasing the rebase index and reducing circulating supply every cycle.
mechanics: Rebase mechanism — index increases as supply shrinks

poop.name: POOP

It is minted through gameplay and burned through 11 V3 reactor pools running on 1% fee tiers. Inflationary by design but deflationary by volume — when trading activity exceeds mint rate, supply compresses. All LP is permanently locked.

char.name: Biochar
char.description: CHAR is a Toucan Protocol carbon removal credit on Base. Each CHAR represents 1 tonne of verified biochar-based carbon removal, sourced from Puro.earth CORCs (CO2 Removal Certificates). Biochar is charcoal produced from biomass without oxygen, permanently locking carbon in soil for centuries. CHAR creates the world's first liquid market for biochar credits. In the MfT ecosystem, CHAR is paired with EARTH and POOP in reactor pools — every trade cycle permanently burns verified carbon removal credits.

azusd.name: AZUSD
azusd.description: AZUSD is the stablecoin from Azos Finance — the world's first stablecoin backed by climate-positive assets. It uses a CDP (Collateralized Debt Position) model similar to DAI, but collateral is climate-impact assets like KLIMA, USDGLO, and green bonds. Users open a SAFE (vault), deposit collateral, and mint AZUSD. As adoption grows, more climate-positive collateral must be acquired, creating a positive feedback loop for environmental impact. In the MfT ecosystem, AZUSD is paired with EARTH and POOP in reactor pools.
